Score Serif (ScoreSerif-*.ttf) is a Modified Version of Liberation Serif, built by tools/build_fonts.py:
the ♭ and ♮ glyphs of DejaVu Serif are added. It is renamed because the SIL Open Font License reserves
the name "Liberation", and is distributed under that licence (LICENSE-LiberationFonts.txt). The added
glyphs come from DejaVu Serif under the Bitstream Vera and DejaVu terms (LICENSE-DejaVu.txt).
